corrected_value.title: Changing memories after reactivation: A one-time opportunity?
corrected_value.authors: Wichert, S., Wolf, O. T., & Schwabe, L.

decisions.quote: In this spirit, we attempted to replicate Wichert et al.’s (experiment 1, 2013a) findings using similar procedures, manipulation, measures, and population.
decisions.reason: The replication target is Wichert et al. (2013a, doi:10.1016/j.nlm.2012.11.001), Experiment 1; the shipped row cited Wichert et al. (2013b, doi:10.1037/a0032028), which was only used as the source for a larger stimulus set and minor procedural adjustments.

decisions.quote: Taken together, the current failed replication study highlights a number of critical points.
decisions.reason: Although some secondary group comparisons agreed with the original study, the critical difference between reactivation plus new learning and new learning alone was not supported, and the authors explicitly characterize the study overall as a failed replication.
